name: Stringcourse
description: A stringcourse: a projecting band run right across the elevation.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 34%; width: 100%; height: 18%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 52%; width: 100%; height: 8%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 40%, transparent 40% 50%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 40%, transparent 40% 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
